title: Miss Helen Webb - Japanese Eurasian

page_data.en:
G 40M 9 55
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7113
Special Branch S.2. XXXXX,
REPORT
Date December 18, 1935
Subject Miss Helen Webb - Japanese Eurasian.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by. DB Ross
With reference to the above named person inquiries go to
show that she is a Eurasian, believed to be the offspring of
a Russian woman and a Japanese or Korean man.
For five years, until her departure for Hankow in the
summer of 1934, she was employed as a dancer at the Del Monte
Cabaret in Avenue Haig. She specialised in Hawaiian and Russian
dances and gave one or two turns most evenings. To augment her
salary she would join the other girls after each performance
and continue through the evening as a dance hostess. Her total
earnings at the Del Monte were from $350 to $400 a month.
Helen Webb is about 26 or 27 years of age and in
appearance is said to be extremely like the famous film actress
and dancer, Dolores del Rio. According to my informant the
likeness is so strong that it is practically impossible when
photographs of the two are placed side by side to tell which
is Helen Webb's and which is that of Dolores del Rio. Helen
Webb is spoken of as being an extremely clever dancer and an
intelligent woman able to speak Russian and Japanese fluently,
also a little French.
I have not been able to confirm the allegation that this
woman was on friendly terms with many young naval officers. My
information is that she spent most of her spare time with
American sailors and an occasional Marine.
As a dancer and entertainer Helen Webb is held in high
esteem by the management of the Del Monte and should she
return to Shanghai she will have no difficulty in getting back
her old job at this cabaret.
This inquiry will be kept in view & in the event of the
subject's return to Shanghai a further report will follow.
D.C. Special Branch
D/S.
（批：Mr Gao, Please send a copy to Capt. Bohn JMS）
（批：L. Copy sent File 88/30 JWA）
page_data.zh:
G 40M 9 55
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 7113
特别警务处 S.2. XXXXX，
报告
日期：1935年12月18日
事由：海伦·韦伯小姐（Miss Helen Webb）——日籍欧亚混血儿。
呈报人：D.S. 琼斯 转呈人：DB 罗斯

关于上述人员，经查证显示，她是一名欧亚混血儿，据信为一名俄国女子与一名日本或韩国男子所生。

在1934年夏季前往汉口之前的五年间，她受雇于海格路（Avenue Haig）的德尔蒙特歌舞厅（Del Monte Cabaret），担任舞女。她专攻夏威夷舞和俄罗斯舞，大多数每晚表演一至两个节目。为了增加收入，她在每场演出结束后会与其他女孩一起，整晚担任伴舞女郎。她在德尔蒙特歌舞厅的总收入为每月350至400元。

海伦·韦伯年龄约26或27岁，据说外貌与著名电影女演员兼舞者多洛雷斯·德尔·里奥（Dolores del Rio）极为相似。据我的线人称，两人相似度极高，若将两人的照片并排摆放，几乎无法分辨哪张是海伦·韦伯，哪张是多洛雷斯·德尔·里奥。海伦·韦伯被认为是一位极其聪明的舞者，也是一位聪慧的女性，能流利地说俄语和日语，还会一点法语。

我未能证实有关该女子与许多年轻海军军官关系友好的指控。我所掌握的情况是，她将大部分业余时间花在与美国水手以及偶尔出现的海军陆战队士兵相处上。

作为一名舞者和艺人，海伦·韦伯深受德尔蒙特歌舞厅管理层的器重，如果她返回上海，将不难在这家歌舞厅恢复原来的工作。

本案将继续关注，若当事人返回上海，将提交进一步报告。
特别警务处副督察
D/S.
（批注：高先生，请抄送一份给博恩上尉，JMS）
（批注：L. 副本已发送至档案 88/30 JWA）

page_data.en:
November 27, 1935.

S.2

Please make discreet inquiries regarding
Helen Webb, a Japanese Eurasian, who is said to be
engaged on espionage work, probably on behalf of
Soviets. Helen Webb used to be an entertainer at
the Delmonte Cafe, but left for Hankow last Summer.
She is said to be friendly with many young naval
officers.

D. C. (Special Branch)

J.S. Jones
JSR 287"
page_data.zh:
1935年11月27日。

S.2

请对海伦·韦伯进行秘密调查。她是一名日籍欧亚混血儿，据称从事间谍活动，可能是为苏联方面效力。海伦·韦伯曾是德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Delmonte Cafe）的艺人，但于去年夏季前往汉口。据称她与许多年轻海军军官关系友好。

特别警务处副督察

J.S. 琼斯
JSR 287"
